sources.basis: Neither statement says the Trust has never distributed; the second only bounds when a distribution could occur (excess 12-month cash reserve above $0.01/share, or Trust termination/liquidation). Status confirmed_no_distributions rests on: this narrow indenture scope, the GLD FAQ statement below that the Trust makes no distributions of gold-sale proceeds, zero Yahoo dividend events for GLD in the reconciliation window, and GLD remaining an active, non-terminated trust over that window.
